clarifications.title: Applicant Type Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The application should confirm whether the applicant is applying individually or with family dependents. Family cases require dependent income calculations and relationship-document review.

clarifications.title: Dependent Count Missing
clarifications.clarification: When family dependents are included, the application should identify how many dependents are part of the case because the D7 financial threshold increases for each family member.

clarifications.title: Additional Adult Dependents Missing
clarifications.clarification: The D7 dependent calculation adds 50% of the main applicant threshold for each additional adult dependent. The number of additional adult dependents is missing or unclear.

clarifications.title: Child or Dependent Non-Minor Count Missing
clarifications.clarification: The D7 dependent calculation adds 30% of the main applicant threshold for each child under 18 or dependent non-minor child. That count is missing or unclear.

clarifications.title: Dependent Count Mismatch
clarifications.clarification: The total dependent count does not match the number of additional adult dependents plus children or dependent non-minor children. The family income calculation should be reviewed.

clarifications.title: Dependent Relationships Missing
clarifications.clarification: Family applications should identify each dependent's relationship to the main applicant so the accompanying-family route can be reviewed.

clarifications.title: Application Country Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: It is unclear whether the applicant is applying from their country of nationality. This matters because lawful residence evidence may be required when applying elsewhere.

clarifications.title: Lawful Residence Where Applying Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: If applying outside the country of nationality, the applicant must prove lawful residence in the application country beyond the requested visa period. Without that status, the case does not appear to satisfy this requirement.

clarifications.title: Lawful Residence Where Applying Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant is applying outside the country of nationality, but lawful residence status in the application country is unclear. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Annual Passive Income Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The annual passive or own-income amount is missing or could not be interpreted as a numeric EUR amount. The D7 financial threshold cannot be confirmed automatically.

clarifications.title: Insufficient Annual Passive Income
clarifications.clarification: Portugal D7 screening uses the 2026 minimum wage threshold: EUR 11,040 per year for the main applicant, plus 50% for each additional adult and 30% for each child or dependent non-minor. The stated income is below the calculated threshold.

clarifications.title: Non-Qualifying Income Source
clarifications.clarification: The Portugal D7 pathway must be supported by passive or own income. Employment or active-work income does not appear to satisfy the D7 income-source requirement.

clarifications.title: Passive Income Source Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The selected income sources do not clearly match qualifying passive or own-income sources such as pension, rental property income, dividends, royalties, financial investments, intellectual property, or savings.

clarifications.title: Income Evidence Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The selected documents do not clearly prove passive income, own income, or funds. Evidence may include bank statements, income proof, pension proof, investment income proof, property income proof, or royalty/intellectual-property income proof.

clarifications.title: 12-Month Portugal Accommodation Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: The D7 pathway requires accommodation available in Portugal for at least 12 months. If the applicant has indicated no qualifying accommodation is available, this requirement does not appear to be met.

clarifications.title: Portugal Accommodation Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant has indicated they will arrange accommodation in Portugal rather than already having it, or the accommodation status is otherwise unclear. The case should be reviewed to confirm 12-month accommodation before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Passport Validity Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: Passport validity is missing or could not be interpreted as a number of months. Portugal D7 screening should confirm passport validity before eligibility is finalized.

clarifications.title: Passport Validity Below Minimum
clarifications.clarification: The source reference requires a passport or travel document valid at least 3 months beyond the estimated return or intended stay period. A passport below that threshold should be renewed.

clarifications.title: Health / Travel Insurance Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: Portugal D7 applicants must have valid insurance covering necessary medical expenses, urgent medical assistance, and possible repatriation unless a bilateral exception applies. Without qualifying coverage, this requirement is not met.

clarifications.title: Health / Travel Insurance Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant does not currently have qualifying health/travel insurance, or the coverage status is unclear. The case should be reviewed to confirm qualifying coverage or a bilateral exception.

clarifications.title: Police Clearance Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: Applicants age 16 or older generally need a criminal record certificate from the country of nationality or any country where they lived over 1 year. If the certificate cannot be obtained, this requirement is not met.

clarifications.title: Police Clearance Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant's police clearance status is unclear. The case should be reviewed to confirm whether the required criminal record certificate can be obtained.

clarifications.title: Criminal Record Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: A disclosed or uncertain criminal record should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed. The review should determine whether any record affects the Portugal D7 application.

clarifications.title: AIMA Residence Step Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: After D7 visa approval, the applicant must request a residence title from AIMA during the residence stage. The applicant's understanding of this post-approval step is unclear and should be reviewed.
clarifications.stage_note: Preserved for a future post-eligibility guidance surface. No longer emitted by rules.py's live eligibility screening -- compliance.aima_residence_step_acknowledged was moved out of questions.json's taxonomy_fields into its post_eligibility_checklist block.
